title: Repair one frozen P10.2 Target and rerun parity
goal: Remove exactly six verified generated V3 import manifests, restore all 52 certified corpus fingerprints and continue P10.2 on new absent paths without entering P10.3.
acceptanceCriteria: The stopped predecessor decision and all six allowlisted file hashes match before repair.
Exactly six generated files are removed and all 52 frozen Target fingerprints match their certified C6c captures afterward.
Repair evidence records the pre/post inventories and no certified source mutation.
P10.2 reruns through the frozen V3, receipted V4 and independent comparer using new absent repository, build and runtime evidence paths.
An accepted run has no unresolved parity gap; otherwise a new stopped decision preserves all gaps without in-place rerun.
P10.3, activation, publication, V3 retirement and IFX cutover remain outside scope.
risks: A broad cleanup could remove certified corpus bytes beyond the six generated files.
A hash mismatch could conceal a different mutation under an expected filename.
Reusing the stopped output paths could merge evidence from separate executions.
A successful repair could be misrepresented as P10.3 authority.
decisions: Use a six-file exact path and SHA-256 allowlist with no wildcard or recursive deletion.
Revalidate every one of the 52 frozen Target fingerprints before continuing P10.2.
Use new absent repair, parity, build and runtime evidence paths.
Keep the stopped predecessor evidence immutable and keep P10.3 false.
